spec.title: Directional five-minute opening-range breakout
spec.source: [Zarattini, Barbon and Aziz, SSRN 4729284](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=4729284), [university-hosted full paper, sections 2–4](https://www.alexandria.unisg.ch/server/api/core/bitstreams/3c2989c4-688d-4d78-8a71-f02690990d51/content). spec.entry: At 09:35 New York freeze OHLC of [09:30,09:35). If C>O, arm one buy-stop at H+one tick; if C<O, one sell-stop at L−one tick; doji means no trade. Initial fixed stop distance is ceil-to-tick(0.10×ATR-SMA(14) from the previous fourteen complete regular sessions). No target; exit at 16:00 or stop.

spec.title: Closing-half-hour continuation
spec.source: [Baltussen, Da, Lammers and Martens, JFE 2021, sections 2 and 3.4](https://academicweb.nd.edu/~zda/intramom.pdf). Their cross-asset futures evidence spans 1974–2020. The added ATR stop and this small-account execution are not the paper's strategy; no source portfolio Sharpe is inherited.
spec.entry: At 15:30 New York, r=last trade price available at 15:30 / previous regular-session 16:00 close−1. Long if r>0, short if r<0, zero skip. Enter after the decision. Fixed stop distance=ATR-SMA(20) of the last twenty completed five-minute bars, rounded upward to a tick. Exit 16:00 or stop; no target or re-entry.

spec.title: Noise-band momentum with VWAP protection
spec.source: [Zarattini, Aziz and Barbon, Beat the Market, September 2025 revision](https://concretumgroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Beat-the-Market.pdf). SPY research uses 2007–early-2024 data and stock commission assumptions, not micro-futures costs.
spec.entry: At each 10:00,10:30,…,15:30 New York, m(t)=mean(abs(P_d(t)/O_d−1)) over fourteen prior valid regular sessions. U=max(today 09:30 open, previous 16:00 close)×(1+m); L=min(open,previous close)×(1−m). Compute current regular-session VWAP from one-minute typical-price×actual-volume bars, anchored at 09:30. While flat, long if P>max(U,VWAP); short if P<min(L,VWAP). Enter next quote. Initial stop is max(U,VWAP) for long or min(L,VWAP) for short, rounded away from entry. At later checkpoints ratchet the stop only favorably; if already breached, exit immediately. Protective stops remain active intrabar. No target; flatten 16:00. After exit, wait until a later checkpoint before another entry; no instantaneous reversal.

spec.title: Twelve-month price-trend benchmark
spec.source: [Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen, AQR research](https://www.aqr.com/Insights/Research/Journal-Article/Time-Series-Momentum), [original factor-data description](https://www.aqr.com/Insights/Datasets/Time-Series-Momentum-Original-Paper-Data). Original benchmark uses twelve-month signals/one-month holdings across 58 instruments, 1985–2009; factor returns cannot substitute for executable pair-level data.
spec.entry: Build daily midpoint OHLC on 17:00-to-17:00 New York sessions. After the final trading day's 17:00 close of month m, S=log(C_m/C_(m−12)), requiring thirteen month-end prices. At 08:00 London on the next available weekday, long for S>0, short for S<0, zero skip. Fixed stop distance=2×ATR-SMA(20) of completed daily midpoint bars, measured from the entry midpoint. Long stop uses bid crossing below; short uses ask crossing above. Hold until stop or the next month's scheduled 08:00 rebalance. No target and no re-entry after a stop within that month. A same-direction monthly renewal still closes/reopens and pays both sets of costs in this deliberately simple implementation.

spec.title: Session VWAP excursion and reclaim
spec.source: [TradingView official VWAP definition](https://www.tradingview.com/support/solutions/43000502018-volume-weighted-average-price-vwap/). It establishes the indicator, not this entry/stop/target strategy or profitability. The two-SD reclaim rules and all parameters are ours.
spec.entry: Five-minute bars; reset at 09:30 New York. For session bars p=(H+L+C)/3, W=sum(volume), μ=sum(volume×p)/W, σ=sqrt(sum(volume×(p−μ)^2)/W). Require six completed session bars and W,σ>0. Long when previous close was below its then-current μ−2σ and current μ−2σ≤C<μ. Short symmetrically when previous close was above μ+2σ and current μ<C≤μ+2σ. Enter next quote. Long stop=min(previous low,current low)−one tick; short stop=max(highs)+one tick. Freeze target at current μ. Exit stop, target, twelve full holding bars or 15:55, earliest wins.

spec.title: Volatility compression-to-expansion breakout
spec.source: [John Bollinger author documentation, pp.2–3](https://www.bollingerbands.com/_files/ugd/58be43_d09c50b6e8ea4afd9af0523ef94de876.pdf), [author's rules](https://www.bollingerbands.com/bollinger-band-rules). His described Method IV includes ADX; omitting it, intraday rescaling, arm lifetime, ATR stop and target are our choices. No source profitability is claimed.
spec.entry: Fifteen-minute bars. M=SMA20(close), s=population SD of those closes, U=M+2s, L=M−2s, B=(U−L)/M. After 125 valid B values, while flat/unarmed in the entry window, arm when B≤minimum(previous 124 B). The arm expires after eight subsequent bars and cannot refresh. Enter long after two consecutive post-arm closes above their respective U, short after two below L; consume the arm on that signal. Second close must occur by arm+8. Fixed stop distance=ATR-Wilder(14) through signal bar; target=2×that distance from actual entry. Exit stop, target, sixteen full holding bars or session flatten. No immediate re-arm until the next bar after exit.

spec.title: RSI-2 pullback reversal
spec.source: [Larry Connors's R2 article](https://tradingmarkets.com/recent/the_improved_r2_strategy_84_correct_with_just_6_rules_-674361), [official RSI formula](https://www.tradingview.com/support/solutions/43000502338-relative-strength-index-rsi/). The author example is daily and long-only; headline historical correctness is not evidence for this implementation.
spec.entry: Five-minute bars; require 200 completed closes. RSI2 uses Wilder average gains/losses with coefficient 1/2, seeded by the first two changes. RSI=100−100/(1+gain/loss); define loss=0,gain>0 as 100; gain=0,loss>0 as 0; both zero as 50. Long if C>SMA200, RSI_(t−2)<65, and RSI_(t−2)>RSI_(t−1)>RSI_t. Short if C<SMA200, RSI_(t−2)>35, and RSI_(t−2)<RSI_(t−1)<RSI_t. Enter after signal. Fixed stop distance=ATR-Wilder(14). Long exit after a completed RSI>75, short after RSI<25; execute next quote. Also exit on stop, twelve full holding bars or session flatten. No profit target.

spec.title: London post-fix USD reversal
spec.source: [Krohn, Mueller and Whelan, final Journal of Finance 2024 paper, V.E/Table X](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/jofi.13306); [LSEG fixing description](https://www.lseg.com/en/ftse-russell/benchmarks/wmr-fx-benchmarks). Crucially, the final paper's tested liquidity-taking AUD/GBP reversal strategies become negative after costs. Dealer liquidity provision is a different activity. No net retail edge is established.
spec.entry: On weekdays with a normal scheduled 16:00 London WMR fixing, buy at 16:05 Europe/London. Exit 16:00 America/New_York or the common stop. No condition on the pre-fix price direction. The delay and exit time are deliberate choices.
spec.exit: On weekdays with a normal scheduled 16:00 London WMR fixing, buy at 16:05 Europe/London. Exit 16:00 America/New_York or the common stop. No condition on the pre-fix price direction. The delay and exit time are deliberate choices.

spec.regime: USD demand concentrated around the fix later unwinds. Persistent dollar demand, news, changing flow and transaction costs can erase it.

spec.title: European morning local-currency selling
spec.source: [Breedon and Ranaldo, SNB Working Paper 2011-04](https://www.snb.ch/public/publication/fr/www-snb-ch/publications/research/working-papers/2011/working_paper_2011_04/publications0_fr/working_paper_2011_04.n.pdf). Its 1997–2007 cost results favor EURUSD relative to other examples; GBPUSD morning/afternoon variants lose after quoted spreads. EBS represented under 5% of GBPUSD turnover in that sample. This is old interdealer evidence, not current broker validation.
spec.entry: Monday–Friday, short at 07:00 Europe/London; exit 08:00 America/New_York or common stop. One trade, no afternoon reverse trade, no hindsight news-day deletions. Respect the actual elapsed interval as US/UK daylight-saving dates differ.

spec.title: Month-end equity-hedging flow
spec.source: [Melvin and Prins, ECB-hosted author paper](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/events/pdf/conferences/131216/Third_FX_Workshop_MELVIN_PRINS_Equity%20hedging%20and%20exchange%20rates%20Nov%202013.pdf?37cad5300a1a2b823aec4ad71d721cec=), subsequently Journal of Financial Markets 2015. Public sample: April 2004–December 2012; pooled explanatory R² only 0.03. [Ben Zeev and Nathan 2023](https://www.bgu.ac.il/media/qsgjpsib/2315.pdf) finds Israeli institutional hedging throughout the month, limiting universal month-end assumptions. Neither validates this retail implementation.
spec.entry: Trade only the last scheduled London WMR fixing business day of each month, if its fix is at normal 16:00. Fix equity proxies as S&P 500 USD price index, EURO STOXX 50 EUR price index, FTSE 100 GBP price index. Compute each index's log return from its final official close before month start to its latest official close published before 00:00 London on fixing day. S=US return−relevant EUR/UK return. Buy pair if S≥0.02; sell if S≤−0.02; otherwise skip. Enter 15:00 London; exit 16:00 or common stop. Missing index observations invalidate the month.
